Message:
ALSA: hda - Enable subwoofer on Dell Inspiron 7559

The subwoofer on Inspiron 7559 was disabled originally.
Applying a pin fixup to node 0x1b can enable it and make it work.

Old pin: 0x411111f0
New pin: 0x90170151
